scope: Current Future Saga Chapter 4 presentation-consumer parity against indexed official content records
findings: Future-Saga-Chapter-4-Research.md and Future-Saga.md expose the same publisher-backed Chapter 4 headline counts as the indexed system/content records.
Both character identities are presented as distinct playable identities and are not flattened into base-character preset rows.

The presentation explicitly preserves unresolved mission names/rewards, individual move/item identities, Ultra Time Patrol Battle details, and Gallery of Time inventory rather than fabricating detail from aggregate DLC counts.
The content map keeps Chapter 4 domains explicit: characters, Extra Missions, Parallel Quests, skills, costumes, Ultra Time Patrol Battles, and Time Gallery.
evidence_boundary: This audit validates current presentation/count parity and explicit unresolved-state handling only. It does not establish individual reward tables, unlock conditions, preset/loadout details, battle IDs, item names, or gameplay mechanics.
